title: Shanghai — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Shanghai: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Shanghai has a population of 24,870,000. China’s largest city and global financial hub, known for its futuristic Pudong skyline, historic Bund waterfront, and dynamic cultural scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 137 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
